scope: Central background queues, storage cleanup scheduling, public extension queue API, queue administration and related schema.
plain_language_review: Applied bro, technical-writing and unslop to each new passage in both locales. Kept exact API identifiers and UI labels.

final_contracts.contract: Host owns fixed UTC-aligned levels 0=10s, 1=5m, 2=30m, 3=1h. L0 retries double 10s..5m; L1 doubles 5m..1h; L2/L3 next scheduled cycle. No attempt limit. New handlers join future cycles, elapsed cycles skipped; per-handler shared leases 120s renewed 30s.

Public SDK requires background-queue and registerGcsExtensionQueueHandler with package-local kebab-case id, extensionKey, queueLevel, async run; SDK prefixes identity. Host rejects duplicate/undeclared/unsupported registrations; failed activation discarded; only cluster execution exposed to extensions.

Admin queue page read only; global system read; filters/search/manual refresh/details, retained evidence and current process registrations, no partial successful snapshot; access loss clears data; no execution/repair controls.

Storage L1 batch up to 60, L2 retention 30 minutes; process claims one operation at a time with 610-second lease; unlimited pending retries 30s..30m, historical dead_letter untouched, deadLettered output always zero. CLI loops current eligible batches, flushes audit before release.

0125_background_queue replaces old baseline; schedule and handler tables, level FK, all-or-none lease owner/expiry/cycle, global audit ownership; no incremental conversion. Separate access schema owned by access-log-schema.ts.

Access flush/retention process local at L0/L3; business audit retention shared L3, ten batches <=1000; access buffer <=2000 or 32MiB, normal flush default ten attempts <=100 events; independent access store does not block business readiness.

regression_evidence.evidence: Inspected schedule alignment, future registration, leases/claim replay, retry cooldown and caps, process independence, public API validation, read-only snapshots, global authorization and PostgreSQL cleanup 60-operation bound.

limitations: No application regression suites executed by this worker. Parent performs required documentation verification and navigation wiring.
Concrete connector implementation remains extension-owned; host scheduled authorization requirements retained.
